relationships.subject: phytoestrogens
relationships.evidence_quote: PEs bind to all types of estrogen receptors, including ERα and ERβ receptors, nuclear receptors, and a membrane-bound estrogen receptor known as the G protein-coupled estrogen receptor (GPER).

relationships.subject: GPER
relationships.evidence_quote: The stimulation of GPER activates metalloproteinases and induces the release of heparin-binding epidermal growth factor-like growth factor (HB-EGF), which binds and activates EGFR

key_findings: Review: phytoestrogens bind ERα, ERβ and GPER as endocrine disruptors with relevance to endometriosis.
